title: Neito品牌色彩探索板
author: 塚本 賢志 / Kenshi Tsukamoto
categories: 应用 / 网页设计,产品营销,极简主义,文字 / 排版,抽象 / 背景
prompt_en:
Goal: Create a clean brand exploration board for a fictional SaaS landing-page builder called Neito, showing the same website and brand identity system repeated in exactly 4 color directions.

Canvas: Wide 16:9 white canvas, arranged as a 2×2 grid of four complete brand/website mockup panels with generous white space. Each panel is nearly identical except for the accent color and soft blurred gradient decorations.

Layout: Each of the 4 panels contains exactly 2 main areas: a large landing-page mockup on the left and a narrow brand-guide column on the right. The four accent themes are: 1 blue, 2 green, 3 orange, 4 purple.

Landing-page mockup details: At the top left place the logo mark as two forward slashes followed by “Neito” with a small star/spark symbol. Across the top navigation place exactly 5 items: Product, Templates, Pricing, About, and a black rounded “Get started” button. Center a large editorial serif headline: “Words become landing pages.” Below it add small gray supporting copy about turning ideas and content into beautiful ready-to-share landing pages, then a black pill button reading “Start for free”. Under the button place exactly 3 small feature chips with icons: “No code”, “Quick setup”, and “Always in sync”. Behind the hero headline use a huge airy blurred circular gradient ring in the panel’s accent color.

Bottom website cards: Under each hero section place exactly 3 rectangular content cards with thin borders and rounded corners. Card 1 reads “Build pages from your ideas.” with a small black pill button “Try Neito”. Card 2 reads “Launching soon.” and includes a small rounded email/input pill plus a black “Notify me” button and a thin abstract circle-line graphic. Card 3 is numbered “01” and reads “Type your thoughts.” with small descriptive text and a large cropped blurred accent-color ring in the lower right.

Brand-guide column: Add a small heading “BRAND IDEA” and a short Japanese-style paragraph block in small black text. Below it create exactly 4 labeled sections separated by thin gray horizontal rules: COLOR PALETTE, TYPOGRAPHY, VISUAL LANGUAGE, and a sample card. In COLOR PALETTE show exactly 2 circular swatches labeled Main and Accent; the Main swatch is near-white and the Accent swatch matches the panel color, with a small hex-code label beside each. In TYPOGRAPHY show exactly 2 type specimens: a large serif “Aa” labeled for headlines and a smaller sans-serif “Aa” labeled for body text. In VISUAL LANGUAGE show exactly 4 circular tokens labeled Flow, Connection, Simplicity, and Flex, with one or more using the accent color as a blurred ring. The final sample card reads “From thought to landing page.” with small subtext and a cropped blurred accent-color ring.

Visual style: Minimal premium web-design presentation, monochrome typography, lots of white space, thin light-gray dividers, subtle shadows, soft frosted gradients, editorial serif headline paired with tiny modern sans-serif UI labels. Keep everything crisp like a Figma brand exploration screenshot. Use Words become landing pages. as the main repeated hero headline, blue, green, orange, purple for the four color variants, and 16:9.

Constraints: Show exactly 4 panels, exactly 3 bottom website cards per panel, exactly 2 brand areas per panel, exactly 2 color swatches per brand guide, exactly 2 typography specimens per brand guide, and exactly 4 visual-language tokens per brand guide. Do not add photos, people, device frames, dark backgrounds, or extra panels.\

prompt_en: A richly detailed vertical mural in the style of an aged East Asian religious wall painting on weathered silk or plaster, with visible cracks, abrasions, faded pigment, and distressed gold leaf. At the center, a celestial bodhisattva-like goddess floats gracefully above a large pink lotus pedestal, framed by a huge circular golden halo filling the upper middle of the composition. She wears an elaborate jeweled headdress, layered necklaces, armlets, and flowing robes in muted cinnabar red, cream, teal, and soft green, with long ribbon-like scarves swirling around her body in elegant arcs. Her right arm is raised, delicately holding a pink lotus flower, while her left hand extends outward in a gentle offering gesture. Surrounding her are exactly 3 smaller attendant maidens: one at lower left standing on clouds and playing a pipa, one at lower center kneeling or floating while presenting a tray of lotus blossoms, and one at lower right standing lightly on clouds with both hands raised in reverence. The background is a deep lapis-blue celestial sky filled with stylized cream and jade clouds, faint flying birds, lotus blooms, and 2 ornate temple pavilions in the upper left and upper right corners. Add hanging ornamental motifs near the mid-left and mid-right edges, and enclose the whole image in a decorative floral border. The overall mood is sacred, elegant, and antique, with intricate linework, delicate textile patterns, muted earthy tones, and a dominant blue-and-gold palette, resembling a treasured museum fresco or devotional hanging scroll.\

Main subject details: At the top center, show exactly 1 bald eagle with wings fully spread, facing slightly left, rendered in gold, cream, dark brown, and black shadows. The eagle wears exactly 1 patriotic shield on its chest with blue stars and red-and-white vertical stripes. Behind the eagle’s head is exactly 1 circular gear-like sun medallion containing exactly 1 black nuclear radiation trefoil symbol; the ring text reads “EST. 1776 • 250th ANNIVERSARY”. The eagle holds exactly 2 symbolic items: in its left talon, 1 golden atomic orbit icon with electron dots; in its right talon, 1 small tan book or document marked with a small blue field and white stars, suggesting the Constitution or American founding documents.

Industrial scene: Below the eagle, create exactly 2 large nuclear cooling towers, one on the left and one on the right, both releasing thick white steam plumes. Between them, include exactly 1 central glowing reactor core or energy column with bright cyan glass and gold light beams rising upward. Surround it with exactly 6 simplified industrial buildings: two tall dark rectangular towers, one low rectangular building on the left, one central cylindrical tower, one domed building on the right, and one low right-side facility. Add exactly 2 electrical transmission towers, one near the left edge and one near the right edge, with power lines extending inward. Use multiple golden sunburst rays radiating from the central reactor toward the eagle.

Background: Deep navy starry sky with exactly 10 prominent white or gold four-point stars/dots scattered around the eagle, plus stylized pale blue cloud banks at both sides behind the towers. Keep the scene heroic, optimistic, and retro-futurist.

Text content: Bottom typography block contains exactly 3 text lines/groups. The largest headline reads AMERICAN REIGNITION in huge cream Art Deco block capitals with gold shadow and dark outline. Beneath it, the subheadline reads ATOMIC ENERGY FOR A BRIGHT FUTURE. The smallest footer reads COMMEMORATING OUR 250th ANNIVERSARY | 1776 - 2026 | USA. Keep all text centered, bold, legible, and integrated into the poster.

Color palette: Use navy blue, antique cream, metallic gold, tan, muted red, cyan glow. The mood should be optimistic, monumental, patriotic, and suitable for a premium merch poster or screen-printed T-shirt design.

prompt_en:
Subject:
Leaping into the morning

Person/Expression:
A woman in her 20s. A facial appearance that combines girlish lightness with adult cleanliness. Long black hair flows softly backward in the morning breeze, with bangs and strands around the face swaying naturally. Bright ivory-beige toned fair skin with a smooth texture containing a hint of pink. Soft highlights on cheeks, nose tip, shoulders, and collarbones. Pale rose pink blush, champagne beige and pink-brown eye makeup, long thin eyelashes, natural eye bags, and soft arched light brown eyebrows. Lips have a translucent pink-beige gloss. The expression is a natural, open smile looking up at the morning sky.

Clothing/Pose:
A simple white top worn under a thin sheer shirt with a mix of pale pink and ivory. The shirt lets the morning light through, with sleeves and hem spreading lightly in the wind. Black high-waist miniskirt, thin black belt, and black lace-up short boots. Captured at the moment of jumping just above the water surface. The body is slightly open to the right of the screen, with the person's right arm extended high towards the sky. The left arm is spread naturally towards the bottom left with relaxed fingers. One leg is slightly bent, and the other is extended downward, creating small water splashes at the feet.

Background/Light:
Early morning lakeside or shallow water. Clear blue sky with white clouds and bubbles of various sizes floating upward. Distant low mountain range and green shoreline. The main light source is the morning sun from the bottom back, backlighting the legs, hair, shoulders, and edges of the sheer shirt. Soft reflected light from the water and sky enters the face, with thin natural shadows. The water reflects the sky, clouds, and the person's legs and boots faintly.

Composition/Camera:
Portrait 2:3. Low-angle full-body portrait. The person is placed slightly above the center of the frame, showing the whole body. Water surface and reflections are left at the bottom, with a large margin for the blue sky and bubbles at the top. The camera looks up from a low position near the water surface. Slightly wide-angle but with minimal distortion. Focus is on the face and upper body, with the distant mountains softened.

Texture/Style:
Realistic morning fashion photography. Carefully depicts natural skin texture, fine hair strands, translucency of the sheer material, layering of the skirt fabric, leather texture of the boots, and water splashes and reflections. Bright and transparent color tones, morning sun that isn't overly blown out, and light lens flare. A photorealistic expression as if actually shot outdoors, not an AI illustration.

Negative:
Excessive skin correction, plastic-like skin, blown-out faces, unnatural smiles, extra or missing fingers, fused limbs, broken joints, unnatural floating, poor contact between feet and water, misaligned reflections, shadows inconsistent with the light source, physical failure of skirts or shirts, unnecessary people, text, logos, watermarks.\

prompt_en:
Subject: Morning Light in a Japanese-style Room

Person/Expression:
A 20s woman. Bright ivory-beige skin with a natural texture and faint pink complexion. Soft highlights on cheeks, nose, shoulders, and collarbones. Precise, elegant doll-like Japanese makeup, pale rose pink blush, champagne beige and pink brown eyeshadow, long thin eyelashes, natural tear bags, light brown soft eyebrows, and transparent pink-beige gloss lips. Small, clear catchlights in the eyes. Looking straight at the camera with a gentle smile and lips slightly parted, giving a natural sense of interaction as if saying a morning greeting.

Clothing/Pose:
White ribbed thin-strap camisole. Natural three-dimensional feel from chest to waist, with lace trim softly following the skin. A light blue sheer summer haori (outer garment) is loosely dropped from the shoulders, paired with light short pants of a similar color. Sitting on a blue cushion on the tatami in a relaxed seiza position, leaning the upper body slightly forward. One hand on the knee, the other lightly holding the haori fabric. Natural weight and wrinkles at the contact points of shoulders, collarbones, arms, and fabric.

Background/Light:
A Japanese-style room on a summer morning. Greenery from the garden is visible through the shoji screens and open veranda on the right. A low wooden desk on the left with a small teacup, and a white vase with pale flowers in the back. Morning sun enters diagonally from the back right, softly illuminating the cheeks, shoulders, chest, and hair surface. Shadows fall toward the bottom left, with faint shoji lattice shadows on the tatami. Faint reflected light enters from the green outside, and the background is slightly brightly blurred.

Composition/Camera:
Vertical composition, realistic portrait centered on the upper body. The person is slightly right of center, framed from above the chest to above the knees. Natural eye level close to gaze height. Natural compression equivalent to 50mm-70mm, focus on the face and upper body, with a natural, not too shallow bokeh in the background. An intimate and calm distance suitable for morning greeting posts.

Texture/Style:
Hyper-realistic portrait photography. Skin is not overly polished, leaving pores, fine hair, slight redness, and neck shadows naturally. Hair is light milk tea ash brown, with thin see-through bangs, a layer cut along the face, and medium-long length below the shoulders. Hair ends are loosely curled inward, carefully depicting each hair flow, thin highlights, soft shine, and a small amount of stray hairs. Fabric is thin summer material, with natural textures for tatami and wood grain. Soft morning tones, with a modest graininess like film photography.

Negative:
Unnatural face or gaze, asymmetrical eyes, excessive skin correction, plastic-like skin, artificial chest shape, extra or missing fingers, fused hands, broken joints, poor contact of straps or haori, floating fabric, unnatural gravity, shadows inconsistent with light source, excessive exposure, unwanted persons, garbled text, logos, watermarks.\

prompt_en:
Goal: Create a dark cinematic storyboard/contact sheet for an action-fantasy steampunk sequence starring Kai, continuing from a previous final frame with no reset: same stormy refinery environment, same lighting, same character position and wardrobe continuity.

Canvas: Wide 16:9 storyboard sheet, approximately 1200×675, black background with thin black gutters. Arrange exactly 12 widescreen panels in a 4-column by 3-row grid. Each panel has a cinematic frame above and a black caption strip below with small condensed white uppercase type, including a numbered shot title and two short description lines.

Visual style: Gritty high-detail concept art, dark dieselpunk/steampunk industrial fantasy, ash-filled sky, brown-black metal palette, orange power-cell glow, lightning-like energy arcs, smoke, dust, sparks, ruined refinery towers, massive machinery, collapsing platforms, dramatic low-key lighting, dynamic camera angles, film storyboard presentation.

Main character details: Kai is a spiky-haired young male warrior in ragged layered tactical clothing: dark cloak, straps, leather armor, metal gauntlets, utility belts, wind-torn scarf or coat tails, soot and grime on face, intense expression. He carries or activates a glowing cylindrical power cell with orange core energy. Keep him consistent across all panels.

Storyboard layout and text content: Include exactly 12 discrete panels with these labels and visible descriptions:

01. CONTINUATION - FINAL FRAME HOLD
Kai stands atop the refinery tower, type-R power cell activated.
Storm clouds gather. Wind builds.

02. CLOSE ON KAI
The power cell glows brighter.
Surface cracks. Pressure symbols illuminate.

03. EXTREME MACRO
Mechanical seams open.
Energy leaks. Electric arcs dance.

04. WIDE ENVIRONMENTAL
Distant refinery towers activate one by one.
Industrial lights ignite across the horizon.

05. LOW ANGLE
Massive smokestacks erupt, pressure valves release steam.
Ancient machinery awakens.

06. MEDIUM SHOT
Kai shields from the shockwave.
Coat and straps violently whip.

07. DYNAMIC SHOT
The platform beneath Kai begins to collapse.
Metal fractures spread.

08. HEROIC LEAP
Kai jumps from the collapsing tower.
Huge scale. Industrial city behind him.

09. TRACKING SHOT
Kai lands on a moving crane arm.
Debris falls through frame.

10. WIDE REVEAL
The ground erupts.
A gigantic industrial salvage automaton emerges.

11. EXTREME WIDE
Kai is tiny.
The automaton towers over the refinery wastes.

12. FINAL ICONIC SHOT
Kai raises the pneumatic cutter.
Power cell energy flows through the weapon.
The titan is fully awakened.
Dust storm engulfs the refinery city.

Shot-specific imagery: Panel 1 shows Kai from behind on a high circular railing overlooking a vast industrial wasteland, holding a small orange glowing cylinder. Panel 2 is a close-up of his gloved hand holding the glowing power cell near his face, with one soft blurred vertical rectangle obscuring part of the face area. Panel 3 is an extreme close-up of a metal machine surface marked with a large R, glowing orange cracks and arcs. Panel 4 shows a wide refinery skyline with many towers lighting up. Panel 5 uses a low angle on smokestacks venting steam and flame. Panel 6 shows Kai bracing against a violent blast with debris flying. Panel 7 shows a collapsing steel platform and tiny Kai amid fractured girders. Panel 8 shows Kai suspended mid-leap surrounded by shattered debris. Panel 9 tracks him crouched on a crane arm with chains and falling rubble. Panel 10 reveals a huge circular mechanical automaton head or torso rising from dust, orange core glowing. Panel 11 is an extreme wide silhouette of Kai on a bridge facing the towering automaton. Panel 12 is the heroic finale with Kai standing foreground, orange power glowing through his raised weapon, giant machine and refinery chaos behind him.

Constraints: Use exactly 12 panels, exactly the listed captions, no extra panels, no logos or watermarks. Maintain consistent character, environment, stormy lighting, orange energy motif, and black storyboard caption strips throughout.\
